summary:
Palantir EPS 超預期 18.08%、營收年增 84.7%，盤後上漲 0.18%，142 倍本益比極高，AI/政府數據分析需求爆發，但估值風險顯著。
• EPS $0.33 超越預估 $0.28，驚喜幅度 +18.08%，政府與企業 AI 平台合約帶動獲利加速。
• 單季營收 $16.33 億美元，年增幅高達 84.7%，為本批次第二高年增率，AI 需求兌現速度超預期。
• 本益比 142.2 倍，市值 $3,068 億美元，極高估值完全依賴 AI 平台需求的長期加速成長。
• 盤後股價上漲 0.18%，市場反應溫吞，顯示 84.7% 年增率已高度反映於股價，驚喜邊際遞減。
• 84.7% 年增率在大型軟體平台中極為罕見，反映 AI 決策平台（AIP）在政府與企業市場的快速滲透。
ai_view:
Palantir 本季財報印證了 AI 決策平台商業化的強勁動能——84.7% 年增率與 18.08% EPS 驚喜均屬優異，但 142 倍本益比意味著市場已提前消化了相當大部分的成長預期。盤後僅漲 0.18% 是明確訊號：在此估值水準，「優異」已是底線，任何不如預期的表現都將引發劇烈下跌。Palantir 的核心投資邏輯在於 AIP 平台在 AI 轉型中的先行者優勢——政府數據分析的護城河（安全認證壁壘）為其提供相對穩定的長期合約收入基礎。短期動能有限（高估值已充分消化）；中期而言，若美國企業市場的 AI 平台採用率繼續加速，且政府端合約持續擴展，則即便 142 倍本益比也可能獲得一定支撐。需追蹤指標：美國商業客戶數成長（USCOM 指標）、AIP 合約積壓量與新簽約客戶數、政府端收入佔比變化、以及下季是否能維持 80% 以上年增率。屬高風險高報酬的 AI 核心布局，需嚴格控制倉位比例。

需留意：142 倍本益比在業績已大幅超預期的情況下仍顯高企，若未來季度成長率回落至 50% 以下，估值修正風險顯著。；政府合約佔收入重大比例，若政府採購預算削減（如美國聯邦支出緊縮），核心收入基礎將承壓。；AI 平台競爭加劇（Microsoft、Salesforce、ServiceNow 均在強化 AI 決策能力），Palantir 的差異化護城河需持續驗證。

summary_en:
Palantir beat EPS by 18.08% with 84.7% YoY revenue growth; a +0.18% post-earnings gain and 142x P/E reflect explosive AI platform demand but extreme valuation risk.
• EPS of $0.33 beat the $0.28 estimate by 18.08%, driven by accelerating government and enterprise AI platform contracts.
• Revenue of $1.63B grew 84.7% YoY—the second-highest growth rate in this batch—confirming faster-than-expected AI demand realization.
• P/E of 142.2x on a $307B market cap is entirely dependent on sustained long-term AI platform growth acceleration.
• Post-earnings stock rose only +0.18%; the muted reaction suggests 84.7% growth is already priced in, with diminishing marginal surprise.
• 84.7% YoY growth is exceptional for a large-cap software platform; Palantir's AI Platform (AIP) is achieving rapid penetration across government and enterprise markets.

ai_view_en:
Palantir's quarter validates the AI decision-platform commercialization thesis—84.7% growth and 18.08% EPS beat are exceptional, but the 142x P/E means substantial growth expectations are already priced in. The +0.18% post-earnings reaction confirms that at this valuation, 'exceptional' is the baseline, not the upside. Palantir's core investment thesis rests on AIP's first-mover advantage in AI transformation—government data analytics (security clearance moats) provides relatively stable long-term contract revenue. Near-term upside is limited given full valuation. Medium-term, if US commercial market AI platform adoption continues accelerating alongside government contract expansion, even the 142x multiple could hold. Key metrics: US commercial customer count growth (USCOM indicator), AIP contract backlog and new customer signings, government revenue proportion change, and whether next quarter can sustain 80%+ YoY growth. A high-risk, high-reward core AI position; requires strict position sizing discipline.

Watch：At 142x P/E with an 18% EPS beat, any deceleration in growth below 50% YoY would trigger significant multiple compression.; Government contracts represent a major revenue share; federal spending cuts or procurement delays would directly impact the core revenue base.; Intensifying AI platform competition (Microsoft, Salesforce, ServiceNow) challenges Palantir's differentiation moat and requires continuous validation.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $0.33 超越預估 $0.28，驚喜幅度 +18.08%，AI 平台需求驅動業績大幅超越。
